description: 臺中市防災公園地圖 [evacuation shelters and public facilities and fire, police and emergency services] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 臺中市政府數位發展局. 公園平時除提供民眾休憩外，災害來臨時亦可作為臨時避難場域，並視空間及地域特性增加收容需求，為提升本市整體防救災能量，經主管機關社會局依「臺中市臨時避難收容處所設置作業要點」辦理評估及調查本市轄內如區公所、活動中心、學校及公園等非潛勢區之公共設施空間， 盤點本市40處公園可作為臨時避難收容處所，本局除提供公園用地供作臨時避難收容處所外，為強... Coverage: 臺中市政府數位發展局. The portal files it under the publisher 臺中市政府數位發展局. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-07-17 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
